description: Build e2e_scenarios.py per spec Appendix A. Scripted end-to-end test covering three canonical flows: (1) new MCP submission -> scanned -> signals scored -> verdict assigned -> attestation generated -> visible in UI port 8790. (2) known threat match -> KNOWN_THREAT verdict -> audit_log entry. (3) insufficient data -> INSUFFICIENT verdict after 5 signals missing. Uses synthetic MCP data. No external network calls. Validates row counts in mcp_server_registry, mcp_signal_scores, mcp_attestations.
